name: chess-assistant
description: Chrome extension that acts as your personal chess coach for Chess.com games

scripts.lint: echo 'Linting JavaScript files...' && node -c content.js && node -c background.js && node -c popup.js && echo 'All files are syntactically valid!'
scripts.validate: python3 -m json.tool manifest.json > /dev/null && echo 'manifest.json is valid'
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run validate

author: Chess Assistant Team
